raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

The Rust server's gRPC adapter waits a fixed 300 seconds for each call's next response event and ignores `--grpc-response-timeout-secs`. This PR allows the timeout to be explicitly configured.

## Modifications

- The Rust `ServerArgs` gains `grpc_response_timeout_secs`.
- `_build_server_args` forwards the resolved server arg.
- `GrpcService` uses it in place of the 300 s constant, for `Generate`'s per-event wait and for `Detokenize`, as the Python bridge applies it to every RPC.
- A value of `0` falls back to the 300 s default with a warning, Python's argument validation already rejects non-positive values.

## Tests

CPU, on this branch (base `main` at `8cd3c494a3`):
- New Rust test `response_timeout_follows_the_launch_arg` (900 s is used; 0 falls back to 300 s) and a new case in `test_rust_server_dp_ports.py::test_typed_config_forwards_resolved_launch_fields`.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo test --workspace`: 547 passed, 0 failed.
- `test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: 33 passed.
- `pre-commit` on the changed files: passed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -133,6 +133,7 @@ def _build_server_args(
         # The shared field is also populated for legacy SMG mode; only forward
         # it when it selects SGLang's native gRPC transport.
         grpc_port=grpc_port,
+        grpc_response_timeout_secs=get_serving().grpc_response_timeout_secs,
         log_level=get_observability().log_level,
         log_level_http=get_observability().log_level_http,
         chat_template=get_serving().chat_template,

@@ -24,6 +24,9 @@ use std::sync::Arc;
 
 use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
 
+/// Python's `--grpc-response-timeout-secs` default.
+pub const DEFAULT_GRPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SECS: u64 = 300;
+
 /// Boot knobs specific to the embedded rust server — none of these exist in
 /// the Python-built [`ServerArgs`]; they arrive as explicit
 /// `Server::start` parameters.
@@ -134,6 +137,10 @@ pub struct ServerArgs {
     /// Optional gRPC base port. The same per-rank offset as HTTP is applied at
     /// the Python→Rust startup boundary; `None` keeps gRPC disabled.
     pub grpc_port: Option<u16>,
+    /// `--grpc-response-timeout-secs`: the longest a gRPC call waits for its
+    /// next response event before ending with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED. `0` keeps
+    /// the default, as the legacy gRPC bridge does.
+    pub grpc_response_timeout_secs: u64,
     /// Log levels driving the access log — uvicorn runs at
     /// `log_level_http or log_level` (see [`Self::http_access_log_enabled`]).
     pub log_level: String,
@@ -252,6 +259,7 @@ impl ServerArgs {
         host,
         port,
         grpc_port,
+        grpc_response_timeout_secs,
         log_level,
         log_level_http,
         chat_template,
@@ -307,6 +315,7 @@ impl ServerArgs {
         host: String,
         port: u16,
         grpc_port: Option<u16>,
+        grpc_response_timeout_secs: u64,
         log_level: String,
         log_level_http: Option<String>,
         chat_template: Option<String>,
@@ -360,6 +369,7 @@ impl ServerArgs {
             host,
             port,
             grpc_port,
+            grpc_response_timeout_secs,
             log_level,
             log_level_http,
             chat_template,
@@ -422,6 +432,7 @@ impl Default for ServerArgs {
             host: "127.0.0.1".into(),
             port: 30000,
             grpc_port: None,
+            grpc_response_timeout_secs: DEFAULT_GRPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_SECS,
             log_level: "info".into(),
             log_level_http: None,
             chat_template: None,

@@ -71,6 +71,11 @@ def _scheduler_for_typed_config(load_snapshot_writer=None):
         ({"hicache_write_policy": "write_back"}, "hicache_write_policy", "write_back"),
         ({"smg_grpc_mode": True}, "grpc_port", None),
         ({"grpc_mode": True}, "grpc_port", None),
+        (
+            {"grpc_response_timeout_secs": 900},
+            "grpc_response_timeout_secs",
+            900,
+        ),
         ({"default_priority_value": 5}, "default_priority_value", None),
         (
             {"enable_priority_scheduling": True, "default_priority_value": 5},
@@ -96,6 +101,7 @@ def _scheduler_for_typed_config(load_snapshot_writer=None):
         "hicache_write_policy",
         "legacy-smg",
         "deprecated-legacy-smg",
+        "grpc-response-timeout",
         "priority-off",
         "priority-on",
         "mm-limits-unset",
